data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native clean editorial photograph, Arm A text-free static-format test
Primary request: Create a beautifully restrained miniature executive boardroom scene in which the exact small Junwait blue smiling middle-finger desk statue from Image 1 presides at the head of the table. The scene must feel like serious workplace editorial photography first; the rude smiling finger-head lands only on the second look. It must never resemble an ad or product card.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole and strict product-identity reference. Preserve one small roughly 4.7-inch-tall matte-blue synthetic-resin character: round seated blue body, short blue sleeves/arms, two tiny flesh-tone hands, two tiny flesh-tone bare feet, and one single tall flesh-tone raised middle finger emerging from the collar that is also the character's long smiling face and head, with the same narrow closed eyes, long nose ridge, and subtle smile. Do not split the finger/head into a separate hand. Do not add other fingers, arms, limbs, facial features, clothing, or accessories. Keep the visible front silhouette authoritative; do not invent a complex back.
Scene/backdrop: a plausible miniature architectural-model boardroom on a real walnut executive desk: a small oval walnut conference table about 10 inches long, six empty miniature charcoal leather chairs, a tiny clear carafe, two unmarked cream folders, and one brass task lamp outside the miniature scene. No people, logos, words, labels, screens, documents with writing, or office branding.
Subject: the exact four-to-five-inch statue sits directly at the head of the miniature table like the chairperson, fully visible from the front and slightly larger than the empty miniature chairs. It stands on the real desk surface, not inside a chair, so its blue body, tiny hands and feet, and single smiling finger-head remain inspectable and physically grounded. The serious boardroom geometry frames the product but does not make it human-sized.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial still-life photography, tactile walnut, resin, leather, paper, and brass; subtle 35mm grain; dry workplace humor; no glossy commercial retouching.
Composition/framing: strict vertical 2:3, close three-quarter view at miniature eye level, statue in the lower-middle focal position at the head of the table, table leading lines receding behind it, shallow but sufficient depth of field so the entire product remains sharp. One immediately legible idea.
Lighting/mood: soft late-afternoon window light plus a warm task-lamp pool, composed and deadpan.
Color palette: deep walnut, charcoal, cream, warm brass, with the product's exact muted turquoise-blue body and flesh-tone finger/head, hands, and feet as the only playful color.
Text: absolutely no added text, typography, captions, headlines, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, badges, prices, or CTA anywhere.
Constraints: one exact statue only; believable small scale; all objects resting naturally; no package, Amazon imagery, frame, border, collage, UI, callout, product label, separate raised hand, extra finger, extra limb, giant human-scale statue, human, or floating object.
Avoid: generic beige luxury room, full-size conference room, cartoon rendering, claymation, mascot redesign, product catalog packshot, advertising layout, AI gloss, malformed face, extra fingers, duplicated product, impossible chair contact.
notes: Generated from the exact saved Amazon source image and inspected at full useful resolution.
This is the selected clean Arm A final; the project-root artifact is a byte-identical retained copy of the attempt.
